import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def fgmask(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); cnt=C(v for r in I for v in r); dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg=max(((c,v) for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=dom), key=lambda kv:kv[1])[0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==fg]
    rs=[y for y,_ in cells]; cs=[x for _,x in cells]
    hgt=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; wid=max(cs)-min(cs)+1

    for y,x in cells:
        a=min(rs)+(y-min(rs))*(hgt-1)//(hgt-1) if hgt>1 else min(rs)
        b=min(cs)+(x-min(cs))*(wid-1)//(wid-1) if wid>1 else min(cs)
        out[a-min(rs)][b-min(cs)]=1
    return out,fg,cells

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter as C, deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
